attacks.claim: Paging covers only boot reverts and offline rate. HVAC fault codes appear on the dashboard but have no alert threshold, and stage advancement is a manual check. A 4.8 regression that controls the HVAC system without triggering a boot revert could run unpaged across a 1%, 10% or 50% cohort until someone reviews the dashboard. The artifact's own freeze/heat protection emphasis makes that the most safety-relevant failure mode.
attacks.evidence: "Pages firmware on-call if boot reverts exceed 0.1% of updated units in any 6 h window or offline rate rises 0.5 points over baseline." and the dashboard lists "HVAC fault codes" with no paging condition. Stage 1 advances only if "HVAC fault telemetry not above 4.7 baseline", which is a manual check, not an alert. ABSENT: a paging or auto-halt threshold on HVAC fault codes relative to the 4.7 baseline.
